SELECT r.REG_ID, r.PACKAGE_ID, r.REG_TITLE, r.REG_DATE, r.REG_PRICE, r.REG_QTY, r.FOR_SALE, r.START_DT, r.END_DT, r.SALE_START_DT, r.SALE_END_DT, r.HIGHLIGHT, r.DESCRIPTION_A, r.DESCRIPTION_B, c.CTRY_NAME, l.LOC_NAME, i.IMG_PATH, i.ORIGIN_NAME FROM REGISTER_PROD r JOIN PACKAGES p ON (r.PACKAGE_ID = p.PACKAGE_ID) JOIN LOCATION l ON (l.LOC_ID = p.LOC_ID) JOIN COUNTRY c ON (p.CTRY_ID = c.CTRY_ID) LEFT JOIN IMG_MAPPING m ON (m.REG_ID = r.REG_ID) AND m.VIEW_SEQUENCE = ( SELECT MIN(m2.VIEW_SEQUENCE) FROM IMG_MAPPING m2 WHERE m2.REG_ID = r.REG_ID ) LEFT JOIN IMG_STORAGE i ON i.IMG_NO = m.IMG_NO
r.FOR_SALE = 'Y'
AND p.THEME_ID IN
#{t}
AND r.REG_PRICE >= #{minPriceWon}
AND r.REG_PRICE <= #{maxPriceWon}
AND r.START_DT >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND r.END_DT <= TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND (
p.CTRY_ID IN
#{id}
OR
p.LOC_ID IN
#{id}
)
AND 1 = 0
AND p.THEME_ID IN ('CUL','HIS')
AND p.THEME_ID = 'FOD'
AND p.THEME_ID IN ('VAC', 'FES')
AND p.THEME_ID IN ('GLF', 'LEI')
AND ( r.REG_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.CTRY_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.REGION_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR l.LOC_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR r.PACKAGE_ID LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR r.HIGHLIGHT LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR r.DESCRIPTION_A LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
)
ORDER BY r.START_DT ASC
ORDER BY r.START_DT DESC
ORDER BY r.REG_PRICE ASC
ORDER BY r.REG_PRICE DESC
ORDER BY r.START_DT DESC

SELECT r.REG_ID , r.PACKAGE_ID , r.REG_TITLE , r.REG_DATE , r.REG_PRICE , r.REG_QTY , r.FOR_SALE , r.START_DT , r.END_DT , r.SALE_START_DT , r.SALE_END_DT , r.HIGHLIGHT , r.DESCRIPTION_A , r.DESCRIPTION_B , p.THEME_ID AS THEME_ID , c.CTRY_NAME , l.LOC_NAME , i.IMG_PATH , i.ORIGIN_NAME FROM REGISTER_PROD r JOIN PACKAGES p ON r.PACKAGE_ID = p.PACKAGE_ID JOIN LOCATION l ON l.LOC_ID = p.LOC_ID JOIN COUNTRY c ON p.CTRY_ID = c.CTRY_ID LEFT JOIN IMG_MAPPING m ON m.REG_ID = r.REG_ID AND m.VIEW_SEQUENCE = ( SELECT MIN(m2.VIEW_SEQUENCE) FROM IMG_MAPPING m2 WHERE m2.REG_ID = r.REG_ID ) LEFT JOIN IMG_STORAGE i ON i.IMG_NO = m.IMG_NO WHERE r.REG_ID = #{value}
SELECT CTRY_ID FROM COUNTRY WHERE CTRY_NAME LIKE '%' || #{value} || '%'
SELECT LOC_ID FROM LOCATION WHERE LOC_NAME LIKE '%' || #{value} || '%'
SELECT REG_ID, PACKAGE_ID, REG_TITLE, REG_DATE, REG_PRICE, REG_QTY, FOR_SALE, START_DT, END_DT, SALE_START_DT, SALE_END_DT, HIGHLIGHT, DESCRIPTION_A, DESCRIPTION_B FROM REGISTER_PROD
SELECT s.IMG_PATH FROM IMG_MAPPING m INNER JOIN IMG_STORAGE s ON s.IMG_NO = m.IMG_NO WHERE m.REG_ID = #{value} ORDER BY m.VIEW_SEQUENCE

SELECT DISTINCT i.ITEM_ID, i.ITEM_TITLE, i.LOC_ID, i.THEME_ID, s.IMG_PATH FROM REGISTER_PROD rp INNER JOIN PACKAGE_ITEM pi ON pi.PACKAGE_ID = rp.PACKAGE_ID INNER JOIN ITEM i ON i.ITEM_ID = pi.ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN ITEM_IMG_MAPPING im ON im.ITEM_ID = i.ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN IMG_STORAGE s ON s.IMG_NO = im.IMG_NO WHERE rp.REG_ID = #{value} ORDER BY i.ITEM_TITLE

SELECT r.REG_ID, r.PACKAGE_ID, r.REG_TITLE, r.REG_DATE, r.REG_PRICE, r.REG_QTY, r.FOR_SALE, r.START_DT, r.END_DT, r.SALE_START_DT, r.SALE_END_DT, r.HIGHLIGHT, r.DESCRIPTION_A, r.DESCRIPTION_B, c.CTRY_NAME, l.LOC_NAME, i.IMG_PATH, i.ORIGIN_NAME FROM REGISTER_PROD r JOIN PACKAGES p ON r.PACKAGE_ID = p.PACKAGE_ID JOIN LOCATION l ON p.LOC_ID = l.LOC_ID JOIN COUNTRY c ON p.CTRY_ID = c.CTRY_ID LEFT JOIN IMG_MAPPING m ON m.REG_ID = r.REG_ID AND m.VIEW_SEQUENCE = ( SELECT MIN(m2.VIEW_SEQUENCE) FROM IMG_MAPPING m2 WHERE m2.REG_ID = r.REG_ID ) LEFT JOIN IMG_STORAGE i ON i.IMG_NO = m.IMG_NO WHERE r.REG_ID IN ( '20260121_03', '20260121_05', '20260123_12', '20260123_13', '20260123_15' ) ORDER BY CASE r.REG_ID WHEN '20260121_03' THEN 1 WHEN '20260121_05' THEN 2 WHEN '20260123_12' THEN 3 WHEN '20260123_13' THEN 4 WHEN '20260123_15' THEN 5 ELSE 999 END

SELECT TO_NUMBER(pi.by_date) AS "dayNo", pi.pitem_no AS "seq", 'ITEM' AS "kind", i.item_title AS "itemTitle", CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(200)) AS "hotelName", 1 AS "sortKey" FROM register_prod rp JOIN package_item pi ON pi.package_id = rp.package_id LEFT JOIN item i ON i.item_id = pi.item_id WHERE rp.reg_id = #{regId} AND pi.item_id IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT TO_NUMBER(pi.by_date) AS "dayNo", MIN(pi.pitem_no) AS "seq", 'HOTEL' AS "kind", CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(200)) AS "itemTitle", h.hotel_name AS "hotelName", 2 AS "sortKey" FROM register_prod rp JOIN package_item pi ON pi.package_id = rp.package_id LEFT JOIN hotels h ON h.hotel_id = pi.hotel_id WHERE rp.reg_id = #{regId} AND pi.hotel_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY TO_NUMBER(pi.by_date), h.hotel_name
ORDER BY "dayNo", "sortKey", "seq"

SELECT NVL(SUM(oi.ORDER_QTY), 0) AS reserved_qty FROM ORDER_ITEM oi JOIN ORDERS o ON o.ORDER_NO = oi.ORDER_NO JOIN PAYMENT p ON p.ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO WHERE oi.REG_ID = #{value} AND NVL(p.PAY_STATUS, 'X') IN ('PAID') AND NVL(o.ORDER_STATUS, 'X') IN ('PAID')
